name: Codex & Claude Usage
description: Shows Codex (ChatGPT), Claude Code and OpenCode Go usage in the top bar with a detailed quota dropdown. Reads Codex/Claude CLI tokens; Go uses a user-configured API key saved in the desktop keyring. No extension-owned background service. Connects to OpenAI, Anthropic and opencode.ai services. Not affiliated with, funded by or endorsed by these providers.
